name: Iykot Hitech Toolroom Limited
about: Iykot Hitech Toolroom Limited manufactures and sells dyes, tools, moulds, and plastic components, and provides component and contract manufacturing services for kitchen and home appliances in India. It offers molddesign, mold making, and injection molding services. The company also provides chair seater base, chair wheelbase, paint bucket lids, tomato crate, water heater body, and tower fan related products. In addition, it offers kitchen and home appliances under the brand ZADASTAR brand name. Iykot Hitech Toolroom Limited was founded in 1989 and is based in Chennai, India.
